content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Define food chain and food web
Explain the importance of food webs in ecosystems
show how energy flows through ecosystems via feeding relationships. Understanding these relationships helps explain how organisms are connected and what happens when populations change.
A sequence showing what eats what in an ecosystem
Direction of energy flow (from food to feeder)
